description: Unit test class for the ProgramWorkflowService in the OpenMRS project, testing behavior of program workflow management.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowServiceUnitTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of ProgramWorkflowService methods in isolation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ProgramWorkflowServiceImpl before each test.

methods.name: getProgramByName_shouldCallDaoGetProgramsByName
methods.description: Verifies that the DAO method is called when retrieving a program by name.

methods.name: getProgramByName_shouldReturnNullWhenThereIsNoProgramForGivenName
methods.description: Checks that null is returned when no program matches the given name.

methods.name: getProgramByName_shouldFailWhenTwoProgramsFoundWithSameName
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown if multiple programs with the same name exist.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldFailIfProgramConceptIsNull
methods.description: Tests that saving a program without a concept raises an exception.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldFailIfProgramWorkFlowConceptIsNull
methods.description: Tests that saving a program without a workflow concept raises an exception.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldFailIfProgramWorkFlowStateConceptIsNull
methods.description: Tests that saving a program with a workflow state missing concept, initial, or terminal flags raises an exception.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldFailIfProgramWorkFlowStateInitialIsNull
methods.description: Tests that a workflow state marked initial must have the initial flag set.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldFailIfProgramWorkFlowStateTerminalIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that a terminal state must have the terminal flag set.

methods.name: savePatientProgram_shouldFailForNullPatient
methods.description: Checks that saving a patient program without a patient raises an exception.

methods.name: savePatientProgram_shouldFailForNullProgram
methods.description: Checks that saving a patient program without a program raises an exception.

methods.name: purgePatientProgram_shouldFailGivenNonEmptyStatesAndTrueCascade
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to purge a patient program with existing states and cascade=true raises an exception.

methods.name: purgeProgram_shouldFailGivenNonEmptyWorkFlowsAndTrueCascade
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to purge a program with existing workflows and cascade=true raises an exception.
